messages:
maria_pm: Quick sync — we need to lock the PRD scope for tool-calling / structured-output work this quarter. Customer asks (big banks + platform partners) are pushing for strict schema validation, deterministic error codes, and clear fallback semantics.
kevin_eng: TL;dr: validation + safe-fallback is highest-impact for reducing production incidents. Full typed schemas + runtime enforcement adds infra work.
olivia_prod: Customers want: 1) schema validation for outputs, 2) explicit error codes when tools fail, 3) behavior for partial outputs (e.g., schema + missing fields). Also ask for KMS/audit hooks but that might be enterprise only.
tanvi_research: FYI: research found 3 common failure modes: model hallucination of field names, truncated payloads from streaming, and tool-side timeouts returning HTML error pages. We should add edge-case tests for each.
maria_pm: Proposal: MVP (GA) = schema-aware validation that returns structured validation error types and a configurable fallback policy (reject, partial-accept, auto-retry). Post-GA: schema schema-driven transformations, schema versioning & rollbacks, KMS/audit. Thoughts?
kevin_eng: Sounds reasonable. Implementation notes: runtime path 1) validate model output against JSON Schema; 2) if invalid, run configured policy. Implement validators in the serving layer to avoid extra hops. We'll need a small rule engine for fallback policies.
olivia_prod: Acceptance criteria for MVP: - Validator in production serving that catches >95% of schema mismatches in our eval set. - Error payloads have stable shape: {"error_type":"validation|tool_error|timeout","code":<string>,"details":<string>} - Docs + SDK surfaces error codes and recommended policies. - One enterprise pilot (bank) using reject vs partial-accept.
tanvi_research: Edge-case list to include in PRD tests: - Missing required fields (server should return code VALIDATION_MISSING) - Type mismatch (VALIDATION_TYPE) - Extra/unknown fields (VALIDATION_EXTRANEOUS) - Truncated JSON due to stream cut (VALIDATION_INCOMPLETE) - Tool returns 500 HTML (TOOL_ERROR_500 with raw_snippet) - Ambiguous enum values (VALIDATION_ENUM)
kevin_eng: Also consider back-compat: if model returns old schema version, we should map or reject based on customer config. Add VERSION_MISMATCH error.
maria_pm: Prioritization matrix: Impact vs Effort. Validation + error codes = high impact, medium effort. Fallback policies + config UI = high impact, medium-high effort. Schema versioning + migrations = medium impact, high effort -> move to post-GA. KMS/audit = high effort, enterprise-only.
olivia_prod: Launch criteria checklist for GA: - Core validator in 2 regions, - 0 critical incidents in canary for 48h with pilot, - Docs + SDK examples for Node/Python, - Postman/Playground examples using function-calls + schema enforcement, - On-call runbook for VALIDATION_* errors.
kevin_eng: Implementation details: store compact JSON Schemas in model metadata. Validation step should run synchronously pre-tool-call to short-circuit bad outputs. For streaming, we need incremental parser that can yield VALIDATION_INCOMPLETE until complete. That parser is small but non-trivial.
tanvi_research: For tests, I'll produce fuzz datasets that simulate truncated stream, HTML error strings, and ambiguous tokens. We'll include these in the CI eval suite.
maria_pm: Scope negotiation: recommend we cut schema-versioned rollouts and KMS for GA. Keep UI for fallback config minimal (toggle + dropdown) and store policy in route config. Any objections?
kevin_eng: No objections. One ask: add a small telemetry event for every validation failure with anonymized counts so product can monitor regressions.
olivia_prod: Agree. Also add customer-facing FAQ: how to choose reject vs partial-accept and examples of how partial-accept merges with existing application logic.
deploy-bot: deploy status: canary validator build queued (build/2026-04-15T14:02Z).
maria_pm: Action items: 1) Kevin -> RFC for runtime validator + fallback rule engine (due EOD Fri). 2) Tanvi -> fuzz test set + edge-case doc (due Tue). 3) Olivia -> pilot onboarding plan + docs skeleton (due next Wed). 4) Eng -> telemetry spec (counts + error_code) (due Mon).
kevin_eng: I'll put the RFC in #eng-runtime and ping folks. Draft will include API for error payloads and config snippets. Example error payload in RFC: ```json
{"error_type":"validation","code":"VALIDATION_MISSING","field":"user_email","message":"required field missing"}
```
olivia_prod: Quick question: for partial-accept, do we auto-fill defaults or return explicit nulls? Prefer explicit nulls and let caller decide. Document both patterns.
tanvi_research: Explicit nulls + metadata field _partial: true seems clear. Add example to tests.
maria_pm: OK locking GA scope. Will summarize in PRD doc after Kevin's RFC is posted. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
kevin_eng: will follow up with RFC link shortly.
